caption: The drawing features a complex geometric and floral composition. On the left and top edges, there is a wide border filled with a multicolored floral pattern, mainly consisting of pink, purple, orange, and green. Inside this is a narrower border that forms a repeated triangular pattern in alternating red, green, and off-white, resembling a series of arrows or chevrons. In two corners (upper left and the intersection of the two borders), there are small squares made up of red, white, and green geometric shapes. The central part of the drawing presents a large, eight-pointed star composed of smaller diamond or parallelogram shapes in blue, white, yellow, and pink, radiating from a red center. The background inside the borders contains faint, unfinished pencil sketches depicting swirling circular and grid-like patterns. The drawing is signed "EDUARDO L. COCEA" in the bottom right corner. The overall design uses bright, saturated colors for the colored sections, while the unfinished background remains in pencil.
title: Quilted Applique Coverlet
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
